lines.en: label kaoricamp2:
scene black
{i}You do not hear gloomy interrupted roars beyond the Serchio? The black-hoofed deer separates from the herd of females and rewild.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你没有听见 Serchio 河对岸那阴郁断续的咆哮吗？那只黑蹄的鹿离开了母鹿群，重新归于荒野。{/i}

lines.en: {i}He'll be sleeping soon in the green bed, within the thick scrub, blowing from the frizzy nose the breath violent that smells of mint. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}他很快就要睡在那张绿色的床上，在浓密的灌木丛里，从毛茸茸的鼻孔里喷出带着薄荷味的、暴烈的气息。{/i}

lines.en: {i}The traces he leaves have the shape, do you know? Of the leaping purple heart. He prints the fat soil in this form; and the stamped clod, which he raises with each foot, then drop.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}他留下的痕迹是什么形状的，你知道吗？是那颗跳跃的紫色心脏。他把这个形状印在肥沃的土地上；而每一只脚扬起后又落下的，是那被踩实的土块。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Ben this one calls the cautious “great seal.” Hunter that you read within signs; and judgment never fails him—{/i}
lines.zh: {i}本把这个谨慎的家伙称作「大海豹」。你这读懂征兆的猎人，判断从来不会出错——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Oh blessed what a head of great blood pursues at the setting of the stars, and kills him at sunrise, and sees the vast body palpitate bitten by dogs and the high antlers of the brow shake the extreme quarrel!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哦，何等蒙福 —— 那颗高贵的头颅在星落时分追逐，在日出时分将他杀死；看那庞大的身躯被狗撕咬时仍在颤动，额上高耸的鹿角摇撼着最后的搏斗！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Gabriele D Annunzio - “Il Cervo”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Gabriele D Annunzio ——《Il Cervo》{/i}

lines.en: scene ilcervo1
I often wonder what the insides of a deer feel like.
lines.zh: 我常常好奇，一只鹿的里面摸起来是什么感觉。

lines.en: I’ve taken notes over the years of their organic structure, and I simply wish to better understand the placement of their pieces for, in my next life, I am certain I will be one.
lines.zh: 这些年来，我一直在记录它们的器官结构，我只是想更好地理解它们各个部件的摆放位置 —— 因为在我的下一世，我确信自己会变成一只鹿。

lines.en: To maintain my health and prevent the cancer from spreading, I must be familiar with my unseen body/I must untangle the various cords and threads to know who I can suffocate and where.
lines.zh: 为了保持健康、防止癌症扩散，我必须熟悉我看不见的身体／我必须理清那些各种各样的绳索与丝线，好知道我能勒死谁、又该勒在哪里。

lines.en: I often wonder how it would feel to be a housefly.
lines.zh: 我常常好奇，做一只家蝇会是什么感觉。

lines.en: If having more eyes would allow me to see more or if seeing more would make me wish for fewer eyes.
lines.zh: 是拥有更多的眼睛就能看得更多，还是看得更多会让我希望眼睛再少一些。

lines.en: There are no houseflies inside of the deer inside of my bedroom inside of my house outside of the world, but there is a fly in a bubble of acid that I left there while making dinner for my latest house guest.
lines.zh: 在世界之外的我的房子里、我的卧室里、那只鹿的里面，并没有家蝇；不过有一只苍蝇泡在一颗酸液气泡里 —— 那是我给最近一位住客做晚饭时留在那儿的。

lines.en: An old man named Andy with a crippled leg he got from his daughter.
lines.zh: 一个叫 Andy 的老头，他那条残废的腿是他女儿弄的。

lines.en: Occasionally, he’ll make goldleaf casserole and bring it over in a 9x9 tin. He got that from his daughter too.
lines.zh: 偶尔，他会做金箔砂锅，装在 9x9 的锡盘里送过来。那也是跟他女儿学的。

lines.en: Andy tells me there is more to life than sating my curiosity concerning the internal and anatomical structure(s) of quadrupedal animals, but I’m more worried at this moment about the long lasting effects of goldleaf.
lines.zh: Andy 说，人生除了满足我对四足动物内部解剖结构的好奇之外，还有别的东西；但此刻我更担心的是金箔的长期影响。

lines.en: Andy says we are all going to die, but Andy is an idiot.
lines.zh: Andy 说我们都会死，可 Andy 是个白痴。

lines.en: He placed 15th out of 20 students in his high school class and works as a carpenter who would not last one shoe in my days.
lines.zh: 他在高中班上二十个学生里排第十五，现在当木匠 —— 换到我那个年代，他连一天都撑不过。

lines.en: His friends call him Il Cervo because his legs are scrawny and frail due to his disability, and how the lower body requires constant exercise lest the muscles begin to deteriorate.
lines.zh: 他的朋友们叫他 Il Cervo，因为他的残疾让两条腿又细又弱 —— 而下半身需要不断锻炼，否则肌肉就会开始萎缩。

lines.en: If he was truly Il Cervo, none of this would happen.
lines.zh: 如果他真是 Il Cervo，这一切就不会发生。

lines.en: He’d find a way to persist with just 75%% of his legs or, in the worst case scenario, be gobbled up by some sort of predator.
lines.zh: 他会想办法靠 75%% 的腿活下去，或者，在最坏的情况下，被某种捕食者一口吞掉。

lines.en: I imagine it would be a human as they’re the lot who kills for fun.
lines.zh: 我想那捕食者会是人类，因为他们就是那群以杀戮为乐的家伙。

lines.en: We’re truly despicable creatures, you know.
lines.zh: 我们真是可鄙的生物，你知道吗。

lines.en: Of course you know.
lines.zh: 你当然知道。

lines.en: But I will never let you look inside of the deer with me.
lines.zh: 但我永远不会让你和我一起看那只鹿的里面。

lines.en: Your hands are far too large.
lines.zh: 你的手太大了。

lines.en: You would only damage the coat.
lines.zh: 你只会弄坏那层皮毛。

lines.en: scene black
Leaves crumple or crumble beneath my feet as I use them to crumple or crumble leaves.
lines.zh: 叶子在我脚下被压皱或者碾碎，而我用它们去压皱或者碾碎叶子。

lines.en: I’m on my way to see a girl who sees me. But what I see right now’s the sea.
lines.zh: 我正在去看一个能看见我的女孩的路上。可我现在看见的，是海。

lines.en: “This shouldn’t be here,”  I sing to myself, annunSiating the laSk of SEAs.
lines.zh: 「这不该在这里，」我对自己唱道，宣示着「海」的缺失。

lines.en: But it is, so I must accept it, making room inside of my heart for the first dame to remind me of my freshly-deceased childhood retriever.
lines.zh: 可它就在那儿，所以我必须接受它，在我的心里腾出地方，给第一个让我想起刚死不久的童年猎犬的女士。

lines.en: Her name was Lasso because I had a hearing problem.
lines.zh: 她叫 Lasso，因为我有听力问题。

lines.en: I was the runt of my litter.
lines.zh: 我是我这窝里最小的一只。

lines.en: Vowels never stuck to me.
lines.zh: 元音从来都粘不到我身上。

lines.en: scene ilcervo2
: Friend! You have come!
lines.zh: : 朋友！你来了！

lines.en: : Aren’t you a little too close to the fire?
lines.zh: : 你是不是离火太近了点？

lines.en: : The cold requires not-cold! So the red child and I set ablaze the limbs of fallen groundspring to better lock our hand’s hands on the hands of the ground-hand’s hands.
lines.zh: : 冷需要「不冷」！所以我和红色小孩点燃了倒下的地泉枝干，好让我们手的手更牢地扣住地手的手的手。

lines.en: : I’m just going to say “okay” since I’m having trouble parsing that one. Okay.
lines.zh: : 这句话我解析起来有点困难，所以我就说「好吧」。好吧。

lines.en: : Do you want to play with us, Dad?
lines.zh: : 你要和我们一起玩吗，爸爸？

lines.en: scene ilcervo3
: Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : What are you even doing over here, Ami? I had no idea where you ran off to. I was starting to worry.
lines.zh: : Ami，你在这儿干什么？我一点都不知道你跑哪儿去了。我都开始担心了。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : I just needed to get some air. But then I bumped into Miss Kaori and got roped into playing some sort of card game with her.
lines.zh: : 我只是想出来透透气。结果碰上了 Kaori 小姐，被她拉着玩了某种纸牌游戏。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : What sort of game is it?
lines.zh: : 是什么样的游戏？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : A card game.
lines.zh: : 纸牌游戏。

lines.en: : Yes, but what sort of game is it?
lines.zh: : 是，可是什么样的游戏？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : A card game.
lines.zh: : 纸牌游戏。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : Can I play too?
lines.zh: : 我也能玩吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but miss Kaori will have to explain the rules since they’re very confusing.
lines.zh: : 可以，不过得让 Kaori 小姐来讲规则，因为规则特别难懂。

lines.en: scene ilcervo4
: The red child is a liar. The rules are not confusing at all. All you have to do is follow your heart and you will have the understanding required to play the game.
lines.zh: : 红色小孩在撒谎。规则一点也不难懂。你只要跟着你的心走，就能获得玩这个游戏所需的理解。

lines.en: : But my heart is a stationary muscular growth inside of my chest that never goes anywhere.
lines.zh: : 可我的心是长在我胸口、哪儿也不会去的一块静止肌肉生长物。

lines.en: : That’s not true, Dad. Your heart moves all over the place. So much so that I can’t even keep up with it sometimes.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢，爸爸。你的心到处乱跑。跑到有时候我甚至跟不上它。

lines.en: scene ilcervo3
: Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : That’s right. Ami is my daughter now. Or perhaps she always has been.
lines.zh: : 没错。Ami 现在是我女儿了。也许她一直都是。

lines.en: : But hey, that’s just a theory. A game theory.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，这只是个理论。一个游戏理论。

lines.en: scene ilcervo5
: And there’s no way of knowing if it was my penis that created her without taking a test that I don’t want to take because I am afraid of the truth and the impact it may have on the two of us.
lines.zh: : 而且没有办法知道是不是我的阴茎造出了她 —— 除非去做一项我不想去做的检测，因为我害怕真相，也害怕它可能给我们两个带来的冲击。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: scene ilcervo6
: Would you like to bend your lowest arms into the position that makes sitting possible?
lines.zh: : 你愿意把你最下面的手臂弯成让「坐」成为可能的姿势吗？

lines.en: : Would you like to bend a fork with your mind? Or are you saying you already {i}can?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是想用意念把叉子折弯吗？还是说你在说你{i}早就{/i}会了？

lines.en: : Confusion is occurring. Will your legs bend or not?
lines.zh: : 困惑正在发生。你的腿到底弯不弯？

lines.en: scene ilcervo7
: Bend the legs.
lines.zh: : 把腿弯起来。

lines.en: scene black
: Yes, I think I will.
lines.zh: : 好的，我想我会的。

lines.en: scene ilcervo8
: So, what am I supposed to do now?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在我该做什么？

lines.en: : First, you must use your eyes to study your paper rectangles. Then, you must tell a story using the words written on both of them.
lines.zh: : 首先，你必须用你的眼睛研究你的纸做的长方形。然后，你必须用写在它们上面的两个词讲一个故事。

lines.en: : If your story is good, you will earn a gold star!
lines.zh: : 如果你的故事好，你会得到一颗金星！

lines.en: scene ilcervo9
: But if your story is bad, you will earn a faceless elf.
lines.zh: : 但如果你的故事不好，你会得到一个无脸精灵。

lines.en: : What can I do with a faceless elf?
lines.zh: : 无脸精灵能拿来做什么？

lines.en: : Anything you can do with a faceful elf, but it will not be able to see or taste it.
lines.zh: : 你能对「满脸精灵」做的事，对它都能做，只不过它看不见也尝不到。

lines.en: scene ilcervo8
: I think I get it. But if I could see the two of you play a round first, it would be a big help.
lines.zh: : 我想我懂了。不过如果能先看你们俩玩一局，会有很大帮助。

lines.en: scene ilcervo10
: I guess I can pick up from where we left off then? Since it was already my turn anyway?
lines.zh: : 那我就从刚才断掉的地方接着来？反正本来就轮到我了？

lines.en: : The sound of those words makes my human ears feel good. Please, proceed with the telling of your story, red child!
lines.zh: : 这些话的声音让我的人类耳朵很舒服。请继续讲你的故事吧，红色小孩！

lines.en: scene ilcervo11
: My first word is pendulum...My second is corset. So, my story is this:
lines.zh: : 我的第一个词是钟摆……第二个是紧身胸衣。那么，我的故事是这样的：

lines.en: : A long time ago, there was a girl born with deer parts.
lines.zh: : 很久很久以前，有一个生来就带着鹿的部件的女孩。

lines.en: : No one understood her or appreciated her horns. And due to the extra pieces she had inside of her, her belly would bulge and make the other kids in school uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 没有人理解她，也没有人欣赏她的角。而且因为她身体里多出来的那些部件，她的肚子会鼓起来，让学校里的其他孩子很不舒服。

lines.en: : So she bought a special corset made for girls just like her. And when she wore it, she’d look normal. But she’d also crush her deer parts and her parents thought that was dangerous.
lines.zh: : 于是她买了一件专为像她这样的女孩做的特殊紧身胸衣。穿上它，她看起来就和正常人一样。可她同时也会压坏自己的鹿部件，而她父母觉得那样很危险。

lines.en: : When she came home one day, there was a pendulum in the foyer- fashioned out of smoke and felt.
lines.zh: : 有一天她回家时，门厅里摆着一个钟摆 —— 用烟雾和毛毡做成的。

lines.en: : And as she stared at the pendulum, she began to feel sleepy. So sleepy that she passed out right then and there.
lines.zh: : 就在她盯着那个钟摆看的时候，她开始犯困。困到当场就昏了过去。

lines.en: : A group of doctors hired by the family barged into the house and took the deer girl to the hospital. And there, they removed her deer parts altogether, replacing them with extra human ones.
lines.zh: : 一帮受她家人雇佣的医生闯进屋里，把这个鹿女孩送到了医院。在那里，他们把她身上鹿的部件全部切除，换上了多余的人类部件。

lines.en: : And while it didn’t make her stomach any smaller, it made her feel closer to normal than she ever had before. The end.
lines.zh: : 虽然这没让她的肚子变小，却让她比以往任何时候都更接近「正常」。结束。

lines.en: scene ilcervo10
: Great story, red child!
lines.zh: : 很棒的故事，红色小孩！

lines.en: scene ilcervo9
: You have earned a faceless elf.
lines.zh: : 你得到了一个无脸精灵。

lines.en: : Aww, man. Another one?
lines.zh: : 啊，不是吧。又来一个？

lines.en: : I don’t understand. I thought that was a great story. Why does Ami get a faceless star and not a gold elf?
lines.zh: : 我不明白。我以为那是个很好的故事。为什么 Ami 得到的是无脸星星，而不是黄金精灵？

lines.en: : Because it was too sad! Only the happiest stories will receive stars.
lines.zh: : 因为太悲伤了！只有最幸福的故事才能得到星星。

lines.en: : Stars are good and stars are special. They make wishes come true and bad things go away. But the faceless elves are mischievous, and love bad things because they are mad about their face situation.
lines.zh: : 星星是好的，星星是特别的。它们让愿望成真，让坏事离开。可无脸精灵很调皮，而且喜欢坏事，因为它们对自己的脸的状况很生气。

lines.en: scene ilcervo8
: But now that you have heard an example, you should be able to make a story of your own! Right, Dadfriend?
lines.zh: : 不过既然你听过一个例子了，你应该能编出自己的故事了吧！对吧，爸爸朋友？

lines.en: : I am not your father and you are not allowed to call me that.
lines.zh: : 我不是你爸爸，你也不许这么叫我。

lines.en: : Only I can call Dad “Dad.” Anyone else who calls Dad “Dad” is going to wake up with deer parts.
lines.zh: : 只有我能叫他「爸爸」。其他任何叫他「爸爸」的人，醒来都会长出鹿的部件。

lines.en: : I apologize for missing the understanding! All I want is to fit there. But sometimes, I feel like I will never fit into any of the “theres” at all.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没能理解！我只是想「属于那里」。可有时候，我觉得自己永远都融不进任何一个「那里」。

lines.en: : That’s probably because you have deer parts.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为你有鹿的部件。

lines.en: : Hahah. Kaori is a deer.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。Kaori 是一只鹿。

lines.en: : Only deer are deer!
lines.zh: : 只有鹿才是鹿！

lines.en: : My first word is saline. My second word is baleen. My story is this:
lines.zh: : 我的第一个词是盐水。第二个词是鲸须。我的故事是这样的：

lines.en: scene ilcervo12
: In the deepest part of the deepest ocean, there was a whale the world forgot.
lines.zh: : 在最深的海洋的最深处，有一头被世界遗忘的鲸。

lines.en: : It never felt much in regard to living a solitary life. And it was so long-forgotten that even the krill would not flee from its colossal gape, so feeding was always easy.
lines.zh: : 对于过着孤独的生活，它从来没什么感觉。而它被遗忘了太久，久到连磷虾都不肯逃离它那巨大的大口，所以进食总是很容易。

lines.en: : As the saline and shrimp were introduced to the baleen it kept locked away where its teeth would be if it had only been human and not a forgotten whale, the world felt like it was remembering something.
lines.zh: : 当盐水和虾被送进那排它一直锁起来的鲸须 —— 那位置本该长着牙齿，如果它是人类而不是一头被遗忘的鲸 —— 世界仿佛想起了什么。

lines.en: : That high, yet low pitched whale noise that whales make was so loud and so all-encompassing that it shook the earth to its core.
lines.zh: : 鲸会发出的那种又高又低的鸣声，响亮而包罗万象，把大地都震到了地心。

lines.en: : But in the core slept a larger whale — and that whale, who had been dormant for decades, did not appreciate being woken up by someone in a similar suit.
lines.zh: : 可地心里睡着一头更大的鲸 —— 而那头沉睡了数十年的鲸，并不喜欢被一个穿着相似行头的家伙吵醒。

lines.en: : So it bust through the center of the earth, causing the deepest waters of the deepest ocean to sink even deeper.
lines.zh: : 于是它冲破了地球的中心，让最深海洋的最深水域陷得更深。

lines.en: : The center of the world flooded, and all of that water disappeared into nothingness as the core was now gone.
lines.zh: : 世界的中心被淹没，而那些水全部消失于虚无 —— 因为地心已经不在了。

lines.en: : Upon finding the smaller whale, the bigger whale had this to say.
lines.zh: : 找到那头小鲸之后，大鲸说了这样一番话。

lines.en: : How dare you steal my shrimp. How dare you steal my krill. How dare you take my ocean and how dare you eat your fill.
lines.zh: : 你怎敢偷我的虾。你怎敢偷我的磷虾。你怎敢夺走我的海洋，又怎敢吃饱喝足。

lines.en: : Forgotten as you may be and as lost as you must feel, I command you keep your role in mind and ask {i}me{/i} before each meal.
lines.zh: : 纵然你被遗忘、纵然你必定感到迷失，我命令你记住自己的本分，每一餐之前都要先问过{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : The smaller whale looked up at the bigger one, knowing it could be swallowed at any second. But instead, all it said was “thank you.”
lines.zh: : 小鲸抬头看着大鲸，知道自己随时可能被吞下去。可它说的却只是一句「谢谢你」。

lines.en: : The bigger whale gazed down, curious. For it had not come into contact with anyone in centuries, let alone one of its kind.
lines.zh: : 大鲸低头看着它，很好奇。因为它已经好几百年没接触过任何人了，更别说是自己的同类。

lines.en: : “Why do you thank me?” it asked, somewhat hesitantly. And so the smaller whale let out another cry.
lines.zh: : 「你为什么谢我？」它有些犹豫地问道。于是小鲸又发出了一声鸣叫。

lines.en: : “This is the first time I have ever felt seen,” it smiled.
lines.zh: : 「这是我第一次感觉到被人看见，」它微笑着说。

lines.en: : “If acting out is the cause of this...if stealing your food and not asking permission to gorge myself on krill is all it took to receive such attention, it will have been worth it.”
lines.zh: : 「如果闹腾一下就是原因……如果偷走你的食物、不请示就大吃你的磷虾，就能换来这样的关注，那这一切都值了。」

lines.en: : “I will betray you a thousand times over so long as it will get you to scold me.”
lines.zh: : 「只要能换来你的责骂，我愿意背叛你一千次。」

lines.en: scene black
: Unsure of how to respond, the large whale turned away. “Be gone,” it said.
lines.zh: : 大鲸不知该如何回应，转过身去。「走开，」它说。

lines.en: : But the smaller whale followed behind it, refusing to leave the side of the one being who had ever acknowledged it.
lines.zh: : 可小鲸跟在它身后，拒绝离开这个唯一承认过它的存在的身边。

lines.en: : When the large whale went back to sleep and restored the core to the earth, it used its tail to carve out a second one.
lines.zh: : 当大鲸回去睡觉、把地心还给地球时，它用自己的尾巴又雕出了第二个。

lines.en: scene ilcervo8
: And now there are two cores. But who knows? There may even be a third. Or a fourth. Or the world may be filled with whales.
lines.zh: : 现在有两个地心了。可谁知道呢？也许还会有第三个。或者第四个。又或者整个世界都挤满了鲸。

lines.en: : There is no way any of us could ever know, for we can only dig so far.
lines.zh: : 我们谁都不可能知道，因为我们只能挖到那么深。

lines.en: : That was a really great story, Dad.
lines.zh: : 这故事真的很棒，爸爸。

lines.en: : Thanks, Andy.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Andy。

lines.en: : Excellent job, Friend! You receive-
lines.zh: : 做得非常出色，朋友！你得到——

lines.en: scene ilcervo9
: A faceless elf!
lines.zh: : 一个无脸精灵！

lines.en: : Damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: : Miss Kaori’s criteria for what makes a good story is a little difficult, huh?
lines.zh: : Kaori 小姐对好故事的评判标准有点难，是吧？

lines.en: : I’ll say. My story had a happy ending and everything.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛。我的故事还有个大团圆结局呢。

lines.en: : It takes more than a sad beginning and a happy ending to make a story storied, Dadfriend!
lines.zh: : 一个故事之所以成其为故事，可不只是一个悲伤的开头加一个幸福的结尾就够了，爸爸朋友！

lines.en: scene ilcervo13
: What else does it take?
lines.zh: : 那还需要什么？

lines.en: : It is not possible to describe. It comes down to a feeling.
lines.zh: : 这没法描述。归根结底是一种感觉。

lines.en: : A feeling?
lines.zh: : 感觉？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : That is not incorrect!
lines.zh: : 这不算错！

lines.en: : When you place your armfoot on the softest object, you know right away that it is the softest object! The same should be said for wordstrings.
lines.zh: : 当你把手脚放在最柔软的东西上时，你立刻就知道它是最柔软的东西！词串也是一样的道理。

lines.en: : Only the best string will receive the gold star and a wish. And all others get a faceless elf.
lines.zh: : 只有最好的词串才能得到金星和一个愿望。其他的都只能得到无脸精灵。

lines.en: : Can you give yourself a gold star since it’s your game, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 既然这是你的游戏，你能给自己一颗金星吗，Kaori？

lines.en: : I can not, for I have already traded mine for Nao-chan. And surpassing the upper limit of gold stars is not something anyone has ever done before.
lines.zh: : 不能，因为我已经把我的那颗换给 Nao 酱了。而且超过金星上限这种事，从来没有人做到过。

lines.en: : What would you use your gold star on, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你会把金星用在什么上，Ami？

lines.en: : I’d like to bring the moon back, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，我希望把月亮带回来。

lines.en: : From where?
lines.zh: : 从哪儿带回来？

lines.en: : Anywhere.
lines.zh: : 哪儿都行。

lines.en: : Like the large whale?
lines.zh: : 就像那头大鲸一样？

lines.en: : You think the moon is inside of the whale?
lines.zh: : 你觉得月亮在鲸的肚子里？

lines.en: : I just think she means that it’s gone, the way {i}both{/i} whales in my story were.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得她的意思是它不见了，就像我故事里那{i}两头{/i}鲸一样。

lines.en: : No, it’s inside of the whale.
lines.zh: : 不，它就在鲸的肚子里。

lines.en: : Oh.
: How do you think it got in there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它是怎么进去的？

lines.en: : It does not matter how it got in. What matters is how it comes out.
lines.zh: : 它是怎么进去的并不重要。重要的是它怎么出来。

lines.en: scene ilcervo14
: This whole world is full of girls with deer parts — things that exist where and when they are not supposed to.
lines.zh: : 这整个世界都充满了长着鹿的部件的女孩 —— 那些本不该在此时此地存在的东西。

lines.en: : But does their inclusion make them any less tangible than those with only human pieces? No.
lines.zh: : 可它们的存在，会让她们比那些只有人类部件的人更不实在吗？不会。

lines.en: : Still, there is a constant push to remove that which does not exist, but only to a certain extent. And no one ever asks what will happen once those parts are gone.
lines.zh: : 可人们仍然不停地在推动去除那些「本不存在」的东西，只不过局限在某种程度上。而且从来没有人问过，那些部件一旦消失会发生什么。

lines.en: : Putting the moon back will be rewriting history. And such a thing can not be done without consequences of equal or greater value.
lines.zh: : 把月亮放回去，就是在重写历史。而这样的事不可能不带来同等或更大的代价。

lines.en: : So the moon will stay inside of the whale forever?
lines.zh: : 所以月亮会永远留在鲸的肚子里？

lines.en: : Everything will stay where it is forever. That’s the law of the world in which we were born, and it is a law that shan’t be broken.
lines.zh: : 一切都会永远待在它现在的地方。那是我们出生的这个世界的法则，是一条不可打破的法则。

lines.en: : What if it is though?
lines.zh: : 可如果它被打破了呢？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : It won’t be.
lines.zh: : 不会被打破的。

lines.en: : But what if it is?
lines.zh: : 可如果就是被打破了呢？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : It won’t be.
lines.zh: : 不会被打破的。

lines.en: : I just don’t believe there is anything in this world that can not be changed no matter what you try to do.
lines.zh: : 我只是不相信，这个世界上有任何东西，无论你怎么努力都无法改变。

lines.en: : Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : I’m not a liar.
lines.zh: : 我不是骗子。

lines.en: : You are.
lines.zh: : 你是。

lines.en: : You have always been a liar. Just as I have always been a deer.
lines.zh: : 你一直是骗子。就像我一直是一只鹿。

lines.en: : But together, we make the perfect nuclear family.
lines.zh: : 可我们凑在一起，就是完美的核心家庭。

lines.en: : Together-
lines.zh: : 我们一起——

lines.en: : We are Il Cervo.
lines.zh: : 我们就是 Il Cervo。

lines.en: scene black
{i}“But in vain we hear the gloomy roars us among the river reeds assisi.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「可我们徒然地听见，在河畔芦苇之间，那阴郁的咆哮。」{/i}

lines.en: {i}“You will not swim into the Serchio to follow the plague, or Derbe; and the cold river will not furrow a suppliant furrow of your arm and your predatory laughter, proud wriggling their muscles in the cold.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「你不会再游进 Serchio 去追逐那瘟疫，或是 Derbe；冰冷的河水也不会为你的手臂犁出祈求的沟痕，不会为你在寒冷中骄傲扭动的肌肉、为你那掠夺者的笑声犁出沟痕。」{/i}

lines.en: {i}“We are helpless and full of beauty, bend down to spy on our heart where it roars, farther than the roar of the deer, the ancient desire for prey.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「我们无助而充满美，弯下腰去窥视我们的心 —— 它咆哮的地方，比鹿的咆哮更远，那是古老的猎食之欲。」{/i}

lines.en: {i}“Now he leaves the herd and goes wild again. Perhaps he is of distinguished loins, and very branchy. Ei più non vessa con nascent horn the peels.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「如今他离开鹿群，再次走向荒野。也许他腰身不凡，角枝繁茂。Ei più non vessa con nascent horn the peels.」{/i}

lines.en: {i}“Already his crown is hard; and his neck grows dark and bearded, and soon it will be swollen with much crave.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「他的冠冕已然坚硬；他的脖颈变得黝黑多须，很快就将因强烈的欲望而肿胀。」{/i}

lines.en: {i}“We will hear his long ones at night muglia, we will hear his bull's voice; rise the cry of his lust we will hear in the silences of the Moon.”{/i}
lines.zh: {i}「我们将在夜里听见他悠长的 muglia，听见他公牛般的声音；在月亮的寂静之中，我们将听见他欲望的呼喊升起。」{/i}
